recursive.description: Enable recursive mode (-r) to examine all subdirectories.

silent.description: Enable silent mode (-q) to suppress non-fatal error messages.

show_all.description: Display filenames of all executable files (-a), not just those with unknown extensions.

bare_mode.description: Enable bare mode (-b) to strip leading directory information from output.

relative_paths.description: Enable relative file paths (-l) instead of absolute paths.

verbose.description: Enable verbose mode (-v) to show progress indicators.

string_length.description: Length of strings to print with each filename (-s/-S len). Set to 0 to disable.

scan_root.description: The root directory or file path to scan with missidentify.
